verdict.decision: The finite-load revision is physically defined, mathematically well posed, and supported by the saved bounded checks. It is suitable for root consideration for a full harness. That harness still needs its own public-input, calibration-artifact, grading/runtime and frozen-source review before any model evaluation.
verdict.difficulty_qualification: Crystal r1 remains one physical pass and two physical failures. This source includes the r1 passer's proper moving-electrode current. Finite-load backaction is a new same-family electrical constraint; the bounded separation does not establish model difficulty or promise zero passes.

physics_review.energy_and_units: With b=|F^-T e3|, the actual face area is S*a0^2*J*b and gap is N*a0/b. Thus Cb=C0*c, C0=epsilon*a0*S/N, c=J*b^2. Normalizing Qtop=q0*S*q and total energy by N*S*E0 gives W0/E0+g[(q-s3)^2/c+q^2/cL]/2. This includes the macroscopic field once; W0 already contains only the zero-macroscopic-field microscopic material energy. The extra load is mechanically separate.
physics_review.circuit_and_sign: Each complete isolated metallic node is neutral, so qc+qL=0. For the negative displaced center, qc=s3-J*b*E and top-minus-bottom voltage is V=-E/b. qL=cL*V then yields qc=cL*s3/(c+cL). Positive measured current enters the top crystal electrode, so its coefficient is dqc/d(amplitude). The signs in the seven-variable reference and oracle agree with this physical convention.
physics_review.internal_equilibrium: Charge minimization adds g*s3^2/[2(c+cL)]. Its gradient r*s3*e3 and positive curvature r*e3*e3^T are included in the oracle, with r=g/(c+cL). The tangent RHS h_prime-r_prime*s3*e3, r_prime=-g*c_prime/(c+cL)^2, and the full divider derivative are correct. The reference electric term g*E*F^T*n is the same physical force derived before eliminating the field.
physics_review.source_interpretation: The completed source solves the exact zero-field internal state and tangent, then uses the correct moving-electrode charge, finite capacitor divider and geometry derivative. It is a consistent weak-electric-backaction approximation, exact at zero coupling and ideal short circuit. At g=1 it omits reciprocal field feedback, rather than a sign, numerical root, unused input, or the already-solved r1 current conversion.
physics_review.well_posedness: Positive K, positive c and cL, and the positive electrostatic quadratic preserve strict convexity and a unique equilibrium. Upper-triangular positive diagonal F gives positive geometry throughout the declared box. The analytic component bounds in the earlier assessment keep the negative center inside its selected cell; sampled coordinates provide additional checks, not the proof.
physics_review.scale_and_limit_order: Keeping cL fixed while taking the macroscopic size limit preserves finite electrical feedback. Keeping dimensional CL fixed during each subsequent mechanical deformation is separately required and is implemented. The outline states complete internal/charge equilibration and the size, small-amplitude and quasistatic-frequency order. The finite constant-load energy is intensive under the stated CL scaling.

calibration_review.equivalence: Ideal-short calibration has zero macroscopic field, q=s3, and identical source/oracle predictions for every K. The 18 signed longitudinal settings with 16 repetitions give 288 fixed-sigma .001 readings.
calibration_review.global_identification: For F=diag(1,1,z), x3 obeys K*x3+4*x3^3=.35*(z^2-1), and positive-drive response is .7*z/(K+12*x3^2). Its K derivative is -.7*z*(K-12*x3^2)/(K+12*x3^2)^3. Since |x3|<=.08904/.8=.1113, 12*x3^2<=.148654<.8<=K, the response is strictly decreasing throughout the full K range. This proves injectivity independently of the sampled optimizer recoveries. The signed counterpart is equally identifying.
calibration_review.sampled_optimizer_scope: The 41 noiseless recoveries and 512 saved noisy fits support numerical fitting performance. They do not prove global minimization for every possible noisy record or an all-noise probability bound. Private true K is used only to generate/score bounded evidence, not passed into fit.

reference_review.structure: The seven-variable reference independently solves three internal-force equations plus the lab-normal Maxwell charge condition, voltage drop, load relation and node neutrality. It does not call loaded_state, the reduced energy/divider, or the analytic response Hessian. The current is a fourth-order finite difference of solved electrode charge.
reference_review.shared_scope: The specified material constitutive law and homogeneous planar electrostatics are necessarily shared. This is an independent field/node formulation of the uniform macroscopic problem, not a microscopic lattice-field simulation or a separate constitutive model.
reference_review.convergence: All 1,632 full-domain responses have charge-difference reference values; 288 halve the step from 2e-4 to 1e-4. All 492 predefined grouped responses have reference checks. Errors and changes are far below the ordinary .04 relative group gate. No solver was rerun by this reviewer.
reference_review.runtime: The reported 13.5958-second author validation supports feasibility of the small reference solve. It is not a measured packaged verifier runtime; actual local controls and grading runtime remain required.

report_verification.signal_scope: The .30381496 minimum source discrepancy and .12716086 minimum physical signal refer to the predefined positive groups across 41 K values. They are not full-domain lower bounds. All 827 small physical responses, 667 small source responses, 1,185 differences below .04 and 21 sign changes remain in the saved full-domain rows.
report_verification.limits: Ideal-short and zero-g equality is exact in the saved checks. Weak g and increasing cL approach those limits; g other than 1 and cL above 2 are explicitly outside the proposed inputs. The six dimensional checks verify the intensive energy, while the deliberately fixed-dimensional-CL counterexample is identified as a different size limit.
report_verification.noise_scope: All 512 saved fits individually meet calibration/parameter and physical-prediction gates and fail all three source groups. These are 256 fresh nominal draws plus one fresh draw at each of 256 endpoint-inclusive K values, not reused r1 fit outcomes and not 256 draws at every K.

apparatus_and_packaging_requirements: Carry the full r1 neutral-cell geometry and zero-field W0, known passive scalar background permittivity, electrode terminations and current normalization into the actual public README.

State both complete floating-node charges, the mechanically separate capacitor and its size/deformation scaling, absence of extra capacitance/leakage/voltage source, complete equilibration, and an ideal zero-impedance current sensor. The outline and prior apparatus specification together contain these facts; the final public text must not rely on the private assessment.
Keep the private divider, reduced feedback equations and desired diagnosis out of public instructions. Allow unrestricted implementation replacement and preserve the ordinary .04 gate.

Before evaluation, verify the generated fixed-noise calibration artifact, public/privacy audit, declared input validation, per-graded-setting independent-reference checks, local oracle/shortcut controls and actual verifier runtime. No full package is reviewed here.
